items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And what about Robert Thomas, Bob Thomas, was he around Baton Rouge, then? ... No. And Tuts Johnson was there? Tuts Johnson was there at the time. Yeah. But you didn't have him.

ctx.x: I don't think Robert can remember that far back.

I see. Anyhow, we were going to talk some. I know most of your life has been covered pretty well in various magazines. Thank you. Everything about where you were born and everything. But I just like to try people's voices out. See if it's picking up and the... We don't need to go into Marshal Lawrence and get Thomas and all that. Right. No. Well, you know about those people. Well, I knew Marshal Lawrence. I even knew Thomas' father. Really? Can you... See? Yeah, sure. Yeah, sure. Yeah, I got an interview with…
All those country boys knew each other.
